gWH6sOCtd2A: "We give a French touch to house" A two hour ride through the wave of French house music that captivated dancefloors around the world from the mid-90s into the early 2000s. Deeply indebted to Chicago house, French producers brought a louche sense of humour and a penchant for colourful maximalism to the genre. The party-forward "filtered house" sound which was poorly imitated ad infinitum into the 2000s was but one aspect of French Touch. St Germain were faithful to the deeper shades of the Chicago source material, and producers like Pépé Bradock used samples to take listeners on expressively arranged and psychedelic dancefloor journeys. bYYXZgIARS8: In the era immediately following WWII, Italy experienced an economic recovery incomparable to any other Western European country. This was La Dolce Vita: the sweet life. Italian films followed suit – they presented Italy to the outside world as romantic, sophisticated, and aspirational.
